problem: The candidate does not constrain calculation cases to the required nltl:positiveShearForce value. Its SPARQL condition merely selects positive-shear cases, so a ship containing only a non-positive or otherwise uncontrolled direction can bypass the entire Cf distribution and FI calculation requirement.
required_change: Add sh:hasValue nltl:positiveShearForce to the shearForceDirection property constraint, or otherwise make positive-shear applicability mandatory for every case to which this requirement is applied.
regression_guard: Preserve enforcement of the Cf boundary conditions and FI = Cf × FIB calculation for positive-shear cases.
